figurative_meaning_bn: পাঠাশালায় পাঠশেষে লিখিত তালপাতাগুলো গুছিয়ে তাড়া বাঁধা
figurative_meaning_en: To pack up the written palm leaf bundles after completing studies in a traditional school
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে স্কুল শেষ করে পাততাড়ি গুটিয়েছে।
পাঠশেষে ছেলেরা পাততাড়ি গুটানো শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He finished school and packed up his palm leaves.
After classes ended, the boys started rolling up their leaf bundles.
history: This idiom originates from the traditional Bengali pathshala system where students wrote on palm leaves (tala patra) and bundled them at the end of the day or studies.
note: Refers to the pre-modern education system using natural writing materials.
